description: Finite browsing of visual content with selection by identity, navigation, gesture and explicit activation.

howToUse: Use it to browse a finite set of covers or visual references and pick one: albums, themes, templates.
Draw each item with `renderItem` using only image and text: links and buttons inside it do not work.
Selecting moves the item to the center (`onSelectionChange`); opening it is a separate step (`onActivate`).
alternatives: A long list to read: a list or a grid of ContentCard.
Slides that people only go through: Carousel.

keyboard.action: Moves to the item in the center and to the controls.
Selects the previous or next item.
Selects the first or last item.
Opens the item in the center.
